amendments.text:
Level attitude with main wheels only contacting the ground, with the shock

absorbers and tires deflected to their static positions. The limit vertical load factor shall be 1.33 with the vertical ground reaction divided equally between main wheels. The limit side inertia factor shall be 0.83 with the side ground reaction divided between main wheels as follows: 0.5 W acting inboard on one side. 0.33 W acting outboard on the other side. TAIL WHEELS
